name: Ray-OBB Intersection Test
aliases: Slab method for Oriented Bounding Box
definition: An algorithm to determine if a ray intersects an Oriented Bounding Box (OBB) and to compute the distance to the nearest intersection point. It uses the slab method, testing intersection with pairs of parallel planes perpendicular to the OBB's local axes.
summary: The Ray-OBB Intersection Test determines ray-OBB intersections by projecting rays onto local axes to handle arbitrary orientations, unlike axis-aligned methods.
